title: Measles Spreads When Kindergarten Protection Falls Below 95 Percent
hook: One measles case can seed a classroom-sized chain.
closing: Closing the measles protection gap keeps one case from becoming your town's outbreak.
question: Did you get both measles shots?

segments.say: Measles can spread to 15 people per case, so one infection quickly becomes a cluster.
Measles protection sits at 92.5 percent, below the level needed to stop transmission.
Measles cases reached 2,566, showing how quickly the protection gap can become outbreaks.
